title: Project Lead-App Development
requiredSkills: Python, Java, Powershell/shell scripting, Go, C++ – for building AI agents and automation workflows.
Familiarity with Langchain, LangGraph, and Langsmith for agentic orchestration.
Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras
Knowledge of Natural Language Processing/Understanding (NLP/U) techniques
Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD automation,
Deep understanding of Agentic AI concepts and GenAI co-pilots
Hands-on experience with one of the platforms like:
Amelia, Resolve, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Nexthink, UIPath – for IT operations automation.
Moveworks, Aisera, Amelia, ServiceNow Now Assist, Microsoft Copilot – for Agentic or Conversational AI
Design, develop, and implement Agentic AI solutions for IT operations (Infrastructure and Apps)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions and Agentic AI use cases.

Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in automation and Agentic AI technologies and incorporate them into the company's solutions.
Conduct regular reviews and assessments of existing automation solutions to identify areas for improvement.

title: OTM Technical Specialist
requiredSkills: Design and implement OTM solutions as per the client's requirements.
Develop and manage OTM workflows and agents.
Integrate OTM with other systems using Fusion Transportation Intelligence.
Troubleshoot and resolve any technical issues related to OTM.
Proficiency in OTM Integration: The candidate must have a strong understanding and experience in Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) integration.
Expertise in Agents & Workflows: The candidate should have a deep understanding of OTM agents and workflows, and should be able to design, develop, and implement them effectively.
Knowledge of Fusion Transportation Intelligence: The candidate should have a good understanding of Fusion Transportation Intelligence and its application in OTM.
A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required.

Application Development: Build Gen AI applications from scratch using frameworks like Autogen (applied or acquired), Crew.ai, Lang Graph, Llama Index, and Lang Chain. Python Programming: Develop high-quality, efficient, and maintainable Python code for Gen AI solutions. Large-Scale Data Handling & Architecture: Design and implement architectures for handling large-scale structured and unstructured data. Multi-Modal LLM Applications: Familiarity with text chat completion, vision, and speech models. Fine-tune SLM(Small Language Model) for domain specific data and use cases. Front-End Integration: Implement user interfaces using front-end technologies like React, Streamlit, and AG Grid, ensuring seamless integration with Gen AI backends. Data Modernization and Transformation: Design and implement data modernization and transformation pipelines to support Gen AI applications. Fine-Tuning LLMs: Apply fine-tuning techniques such as PEFT, QLo RA, and Lo RA to optimize LLMs for specific use cases. LLMOps Implementation: Set up and manage LLMOps pipelines for continuous integration, deployment, and monitoring. Large-Scale Data Handling & Architecture: Design and implement architectures for handling large-scale structured and unstructured data. Collaboration and Communication: Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

title: IT Asset Management - Sr Project Lead-Cloud & Infra Engg
requiredSkills: Develop and implement IT asset management policies, procedures, and standards in accordance with ITIL guidelines.
Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all hardware and software assets across the organization.
Oversee the entire asset lifecycle, including procurement, deployment, maintenance, renewal, and disposal.
Track license compliance and usage for software assets to avoid legal and financial risks.
Coordinate with procurement, finance, and IT teams to ensure proper asset acquisition and allocation.
Monitor asset performance, depreciation, and end-of-life schedules to inform budgeting and refresh cycles.
Conduct regular audits and reconciliations of physical and digital assets.
Maintain asset records in the configuration management database (CMDB) and ensure data integrity.
Support incident, problem, and change management processes with accurate asset information.
Generate reports and analytics to support decision-making regarding cost optimization and risk mitigation.
Facilitate the secure and environmentally responsible disposal of retired assets.
Stay updated on ITIL practices and industry trends related to asset management.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Experience with IT asset management, preferably in an ITIL-driven environment.
Knowledge of ITIL framework, especially Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM).
Strong analytical and organizational skills.
Familiarity with asset management tools and CMDB systems.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Understanding of software licensing models and compliance requirements.
ITIL Foundation Certification
Certified IT Asset Manager (CITAM) or similar asset management certification
Accuracy of asset inventory records
License compliance rate
Asset utilization and optimization metrics
Audit findings and resolution rates
Cost savings achieved through effective asset management
jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility The IT Asset Management (ITAM) professional is responsible for managing and controlling the IT assets within an organization throughout their lifecycle, in alignment with ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) best practices. This role ensures that assets are effectively tracked, utilized, and maintained to optimize cost, support IT service delivery, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and regulations. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement IT asset management policies, procedures, and standards in accordance with ITIL guidelines. Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all hardware and software assets across the organization. Oversee the entire asset lifecycle, including procurement, deployment, maintenance, renewal, and disposal. Track license compliance and usage for software assets to avoid legal and financial risks. Coordinate with procurement, finance, and IT teams to ensure proper asset acquisition and allocation. Monitor asset performance, depreciation, and end-of-life schedules to inform budgeting and refresh cycles. Conduct regular audits and reconciliations of physical and digital assets. Maintain asset records in the configuration management database (CMDB) and ensure data integrity. Support incident, problem, and change management processes with accurate asset information. Generate reports and analytics to support decision-making regarding cost optimization and risk mitigation. Facilitate the secure and environmentally responsible disposal of retired assets. Stay updated on ITIL practices and industry trends related to asset management. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience). Experience with IT asset management, preferably in an ITIL-driven environment. Knowledge of ITIL framework, especially Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM). Strong analytical and organizational skills. Familiarity with asset management tools and CMDB systems. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Understanding of software licensing models and compliance requirements. Preferred Certifications ITIL Foundation Certification Certified IT Asset Manager (CITAM) or similar asset management certification Reporting Structure The IT Asset Management professional typically reports to the IT Service Manager, IT Operations Manager, or a similar leadership role within the IT department. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy of asset inventory records License compliance rate Asset utilization and optimization metrics Audit findings and resolution rates Cost savings achieved through effective asset management Additional Notes The scope and specific duties of this role may vary depending on the organization’s size, industry, and IT complexity. However, adherence to ITIL’s structured approach to asset management is essential for ensuring reliable service delivery and regulatory compliance. title: Azure Subcontractor
jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility JD, for a Databricks developer` We are looking for an experienced Databricks Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions using Databricks. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Apache Spark, Python, SQL, and cloud-based data engineering technologies to support enterprise data integration and analytics initiatives. Key Responsibilities • Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks. • Develop scalable data processing frameworks using Apache Spark (Py Spark). • Build and optimize batch and streaming data pipelines. • Integrate data from multiple sources such as databases, APIs, cloud storage, and enterprise applications. • Implement data transformation, cleansing, and validation processes. • Develop Delta Lake tables and optimize data storage using partitioning and Z-Ordering. • Create reusable notebooks, workflows, and jobs in Databricks. • Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline failures and performance issues. • Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to understand data requirements. • Follow coding standards, version control, and CI/CD best practices. • Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions. Technical Skills Mandatory Skills • Strong experience with Databricks • Expertise in Apache Spark / Py Spark • Proficiency in Python • Strong SQL skills • Experience with ETL/ELT development • Experience with Delta Lake • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts • Experience with Git and version control Preferred Skills • Experience with cloud platforms: o Microsoft Azure – Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory o Amazon Web Services – S3, Glue, EMR o Google Cloud – Big Query, Cloud Storage • Experience with streaming technologies such as Spark Structured Streaming. • Knowledge of orchestration tools such as Airflow. • Understanding of data governance and security concepts. Nice to Have • Experience with Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers). • Knowledge of Unity Catalog. • Experience in performance tuning and cost optimization in Databricks. • Exposure to Dev Ops and CI/CD pipelines. • Certification in Databricks or cloud platforms. title: Python Full Stack Technical Lead
jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility Key Responsibilities Architecture & Solution Design • Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack applications. • Define end-to-end architecture including frontend, backend, APIs, and data layers. • Establish and enforce design patterns, coding standards, and best practices. • Drive cloud-native architecture on Azure, ensuring scalability, resilience, and cost optimization. ________________________________________ Technical Leadership & Delivery • Lead and mentor a cross-functional development team (frontend + backend). • Provide hands-on development support in Python-based frameworks (Flask/Fast API/Django). • Own end-to-end solution delivery, code quality, and release management. • Conduct code reviews, technical design reviews, and performance tuning. • Drive Agile delivery practices, sprint planning, and backlog prioritization. ________________________________________ Full Stack Development • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Python. • Build rich UI components using Java Script frameworks (React/Angular/Vue). • Ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend systems. • Work on database design, optimization, and data modeling (SQL/No SQL). ________________________________________ Cloud & Dev Ops • Architect and manage solutions on Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, AKS, Storage, etc.). • Implement CI/CD pipelines, Dev Ops practices, and infrastructure as code. • Ensure application security, monitoring, and observability. title: Project Manager - Infrastructure
requiredSkills: Plan, initiate, and execute complex and/or multiple infrastructure projects.
Support and coordinate international system integrations as part of enterprise initiatives.
Coordinate and support email and Office 365 migration activities, including merger-related efforts.
Facilitate IT project execution by ensuring quality, completeness, tracking, and reporting of work items across teams.
Create, manage, and maintain project charters, schedules, risk management plans, communication plans, budgets, gate reviews, and related documentation.
Collaborate with project team members and management to secure required resources and funding.
Coordinate work across client, internal, and vendor-based teams.
Analyze project performance, including actual versus planned variances.
Manage project closing activities, including operational transition planning and execution.
Provide project leadership and guidance to support consistent and reliable delivery.
Apply standard project management methods and tools to support repeatable delivery.
Engage with end users to understand use cases, requirements, and issues.
Provide regular status updates and maintain project metrics to ensure transparency.
Ensure projects comply with audit and governance requirements.
Oberall 12+ years with 4-6 years of IT Infrastructure Project Management experience with successful delivery of multiple projects.
Experience supporting infrastructure initiatives such as system integrations, data center projects, server builds, network and storage implementations, cloud solutions, and office technology changes.
Strong facilitation skills to support productive team discussions.
Experience using Project and Portfolio Management tools (MS Project, SharePoint, etc.).
Understanding of requirements gathering, testing coordination, and release processes.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
Strong organizational and analytical skills.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and identify project risks.
Collaborative team player who works effectively with technical and business partners.
Customer‑focused approach with attention to end‑user impact.

title: Sr Technical Lead-App Development
jobDescription: Long Description Generative AI Solution / Data Science Sr. Lead Experience: 8-10 Years Gen AI Experience: Minimum 2 Years Location: Noida, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Mumbai Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Cloud Platform: GCP (Mandatory) Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Generative AI and Data Science professional to lead the design and development of AI-driven solutions. The candidate should have strong experience in Generative AI, Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Data Science, and GCP technologies. The role involves solution design, stakeholder communication, technical leadership, and delivery of scalable AI solutions. Key Responsibilities Design and develop Generative AI solutions using LLMs, NLP, RAG, and Vector Databases. Lead architecture discussions and provide technical guidance to development teams. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver AI solutions. Develop Proof of Concepts (POCs) and support proposal and solutioning activities. Build and deploy AI models in production environments. Work on AI solution scalability, performance, and reliability. Guide teams in implementing solutions using Python, Fast API, Flask, SQL, and Java Script. Stay updated with the latest advancements in Gen AI and Data Science technologies. Mentor team members and drive best practices across projects. Ensure successful delivery of AI initiatives from design to deployment. Required Skills Strong experience in Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science. Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs). Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks. Strong knowledge of NLP, text analytics, and vector databases. Experience with GCP services, preferably Vertex AI. Knowledge of API development, security, and authentication. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Microservices, and Serverless Architecture. Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with Fast API, Flask, SQL, and Java Script. Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Skills Experience with AI Search and Vector Database technologies. Exposure to AI solution architecture and enterprise-scale implementations. Experience working on client-facing AI projects. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Note for Candidates Candidates with strong hands-on experience in Gen AI, Data Science, LLMs, Agentic AI Frameworks, RAG, and GCP/Vertex AI will be preferred.

title: Agentci AI Technical Lead-App Development
requiredSkills: Develop, configure, and deploy AI agents using Aisera’s platform and comparable agentic AI toolsets to solve real-world client workflows.
Build autonomous and multi-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool selection, and task execution.
Design and implement RAG pipelines, function/tool calling, memory and context management, and agent orchestration.
Integrate agents with external systems — APIs, webhooks, databases, CRMs, ITSM platforms, and data pipelines — for seamless workflow execution.
Apply prompt engineering and configuration tuning to optimize agent accuracy, latency, and cost in complex enterprise environments.
Translate business requirements into functional and technical agent designs; run interactive demos and PoCs and iterate on feedback.
Build scalable backend services/microservices for AI applications; ensure testing, monitoring, and CI/CD best practices.
Implement AI governance, security, and compliance controls (auth flows, responsible-AI safeguards, observability of agent behavior).
Troubleshoot, monitor, and continuously improve deployed agents using data-driven evaluation (A/B testing, performance monitoring).
8–12 years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or systems integration, with recent hands-on Agentic AI / LLM delivery.
Hands-on experience with Aisera or comparable agentic AI / conversational AIOps platforms (ServiceNow AI Agents, Automation Anywhere, similar).
Strong programming in Python (primary), plus Java and/or JavaScript; clean, efficient, production-quality code.
Proven experience building agents with LLM frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or PydanticAI.
Solid understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, function calling, and agent evaluation.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent architectures (preferred).
Integration experience: REST APIs, webhooks, data pipelines; OAuth/OIDC/JWT authorization flows.
Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, or GCP, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD, and monitoring.
Familiarity with AI/LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, ELK) is highly desirable.
Strong problem-solving, customer-facing communication, and the ability to work independently.
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
Relevant cloud/AI certifications are a plus.
Knowledge of AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001) is a nice-to-have.

title: Technical Lead-Data Engg
requiredSkills: Design and build data extraction pipelines from source ERP systems; manage data ingestion into cloud-based staging environments; validate completeness and structure post-extraction.
Execute data profiling and analysis; prepare source-to-target mapping workbooks and data dictionaries for business review and sign-off.
Apply cleansing, standardization, and validation rules to master and transactional data objects; manage exception handling and remediation workflows.
Execute enrichment processes to address missing or incomplete data attributes; coordinate with functional stakeholders on data quality decisions.
Run deduplication processes; apply survivorship logic; produce consolidated golden records for business approval.
Build transformation pipelines to convert cleansed data into target-system import formats (IDOCs, BAPIs, flat files, or API payloads); manage sequencing and load dependencies.
Execute data loads into the target ERP system; perform post-load reconciliation — source-to-target variance analysis, fallout reporting, and correction logging.
Maintain detailed documentation — mapping workbooks, profiling reports, transformation specifications, reconciliation reports, and audit trails.
Contribute to building reusable pipeline logic and migration assets for efficiency in future execution cycles.
6–8 years in data engineering or data migration, with at least 3+ years on enterprise ERP migration projects.
Strong understanding of ERP data structures — master data (Item, Vendor, Customer, BOM) and transactional data (PO, SO, Invoices, Inventory).
Hands-on experience with ERP data loading mechanisms — IDOCs, BAPIs, LSMW, batch loaders, APIs, or equivalent import methods.
Proficiency in SQL and Python/PySpark for data transformation, pipeline development, and automation.
Experience with cloud data services — AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift), Azure (Data Factory, Synapse), or Databricks for building scalable data pipelines.
Strong expertise in data quality disciplines — profiling, cleansing, standardization, deduplication, enrichment, and reconciliation.
Experience with iterative migration execution — Mock, SIT, UAT, and Production load cycles with progressive data coverage.
Ability to work with AI/ML-generated outputs (mappings, rules, confidence scores) and operationalize them into repeatable pipelines.
Strong documentation and communication skills — professional mapping workbooks, profiling reports, and reconciliation artifacts.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows.
Experience in Healthcare, MedTech, or Life Sciences data migration involving regulated data.
Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and audit trail requirements for compliance-driven environments.
Prior experience working in teams that leverage AI/ML for data quality or migration automation.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field. Cloud or data certifications (AWS Data, Azure Data Engineer, Databricks) are a plus.

title: Lead Business Analyst
jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility Job Title: Senior Business Analyst Location: Offshore – India Experience: 8–12 Years Employment Type: Full-time Job Summary We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with deep Life Sciences Regulatory expertise to lead requirements and delivery support for Veeva Vault RIM product migration to Amazon S3. The role combines strong regulatory domain knowledge with hands-on BA leadership across epics, user stories, Agile delivery, dbt transformations, and downstream BI reporting in a highly regulated environment. Key Responsibilities Regulatory & Business Leadership • Act as the primary functional partner for Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, and Compliance stakeholders. • Lead analysis of regulatory processes and data domains including submissions, product, labelling, safety, manufacturing, and compliance data. • Translate regulatory and compliance needs into clear functional, data, and reporting requirements. Requirements Management & BA Ownership • Lead end-to-end requirements lifecycle including elicitation, analysis, documentation, review, approval, and sign-off. • Define and manage epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria. • Maintain traceability between business requirements, data transformations, and BI reports. • Facilitate requirement walkthroughs, impact analysis, and change management. Snowflake, Ingestion & dbt Transformation Oversight • Lead business requirements for Snowflake migration and data ingestion initiatives. • Own source-to-target mappings, business rules, and data quality requirements implemented via dbt models. • Partner with data engineering teams to review dbt transformations, testing approaches, and documentation. Data Quality, Validation & UAT • Define data validation, reconciliation, and acceptance criteria for regulatory datasets. • Lead UAT planning, execution, defect triage, and business sign-off in collaboration with development and QA teams. • Ensure regulatory accuracy, audit readiness, and end-to-end data lineage. Agile Delivery & Collaboration • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. • Manage and track work items using Jira; maintain BA artifacts and documentation in Confluence. • Collaborate closely with data engineers, platform administrators, QA, and BI teams to ensure timely and quality delivery. • Mentor junior BAs and provide functional leadership across workstreams. ________________________________________ Required Skills & Qualifications • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, IT, or related field. • 8+ years of Business Analyst experience in Life Sciences, with strong Regulatory domain focus. • Proven experience on Snowflake migration, ingestion, and analytics programs. • Expertise in epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, UAT, and Agile delivery practices. • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and enterprise requirement management tools. • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills. title: AWS DevOps
jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility About Birlasoft: Birlasoft, a powerhouse where domain expertise, enterprise solutions, and digital technologies converge to redefine business processes. We take pride in our consultative and design thinking approach, driving societal progress by enabling our customers to run businesses with unmatched efficiency and innovation. As part of the CK Birla Group, a multibillion-dollar enterprise, we boast a 12,500+ professional team committed to upholding the Group's 162-year legacy. Our core values prioritize Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives, along with Corporate Sustainable Responsibility (CSR) activities, demonstrating our dedication to building inclusive and sustainable communities. Join us in shaping a future where technology seamlessly aligns with purpose. Key Responsibilities Analyze existing .NET application architecture and define cloud migration strategies (re-host, re-platform, refactor). Migrate applications to AWS, specifically leveraging ECS (Elastic Container Service) for containerized deployments. Containerize .NET applications using Docker and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments. Design and implement scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native solutions. Perform application modernization, including breaking monoliths into microservices (where applicable). Configure and manage AWS services such as ECS, ECR, EC2, ALB, S3, RDS, IAM, Cloud Watch, and VPC. Optimize application performance, availability, and cost post-migration. Ensure security best practices (IAM roles, secrets management, network security). Collaborate with Dev Ops, development, and infrastructure teams for seamless migration and deployment. Troubleshoot migration issues and provide production support during transition phases. Required Skills & Experience Technical Skills Strong experience in .NET / .NET Core / ASP.NET Core application development. Hands-on experience with AWS services, especially: ECS (Fargate/EC2) ECR (container registry) EC2, S3, RDS, Cloud Watch Experience in containerization (Docker) and orchestration using ECS. Knowledge of CI/CD tools (Azure Dev Ops, Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, etc.). Familiarity with microservices architecture and REST APIs. Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, Cloud Formation). Strong understanding of networking concepts (VPC, subnets, load balancers). title: Architect
jobDescription:
Area(s) of responsibility About Birlasoft: Birlasoft, a global leader at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and Digital technologies, seamlessly blends domain expertise with enterprise solutions. The company’s consultative and design-thinking approach empowers societies worldwide, enhancing the efficiency and productivity of businesses. As part of the multibillion-dollar diversified CKA Birla Group, Birlasoft with its 12,000+ professionals, is committed to continuing the Group’s 170-year heritage of building sustainable communities.
1. About the Job – Ability to relate the product functionality to business processes, and thus offer implementation advice to customers on how to meet their various business scenarios.
2. Job Title – Apriso Architect
3. Location: Bangalore/Pune/Mumbai/Noida/Hyderabad/Chennai
4. Educational Background – Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Technology or equivalent
5.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Technology or equivalent Experience: • Minimum 10-15 years in MES and Manufacturing domain • 5+ years of object-oriented programming experience • Should have working experience in any of the Apriso version starting 2016 till 2021 or latest • Good knowledge and working experience in o Apriso Production o Apriso Quality o Apriso Warehouse o Apriso Maintenance o Apriso Time & Labor o Apriso Process Builder, Machine Integrator, Business Integrator • Good knowledge of Apriso dashboard and MPI is added advantage • Must be proficient in Java Script/ C# Script and SQL Server/Oracle • Must have hands-on experience in creating as-is and to-be process documentation, user requirements, functional specifications, technical design documents, user manuals, and functional design specifications. • CSS/HTML, AJAX, j Query, JSON knowledge is a plus Experience in Apriso • Must have been part of one or more end to end MES implementations using any of the Apriso version mentioned above • Well versed with deployment and release management processes through GPM • Hands-on experience on Process Builder, Machine Integration and Business Integration. • Must have built mapping for ERP integration and OPC integration • Well versed with deployment and release management processes through GPM • Familiar with source control/versioning concepts and creating scripts for database objects • Well versed with SDLC methodologies

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Create appropriate technical designs based on functional specifications • Author processes in Apriso using Process Builder • Build interfaces and mapping using Apriso or third-party tools • Configure and develop required extensions to the Apriso software suite • Configure and develop required interfaces to disparate external system and hardware • Create appropriate technical and functional test plans and ensure quality of developed software • Execution of system and integration testing at customer site together with customer • Provide technical support for MES system until transition to support • Ensure overall quality of final solution • Manage small team of analysts, developers, testers or engineers and drive delivery of a small module within a project (Delivery/Maintenance/Testing)

title: SAP SD Architect
jobDescription:
About Birlasoft: Birlasoft, a global leader at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and Digital technologies, seamlessly blends domain expertise with enterprise solutions. The company’s consultative and design-thinking approach empowers societies worldwide, enhancing the efficiency and productivity of businesses. As part of the multibillion-dollar diversified CKA Birla Group, Birlasoft with its 12,000+ professionals, is committed to continuing the Group’s 170-year heritage of building sustainable communities. About the Job – We are looking for SAP SD Architect. Educational Background – Any Graduate. Experience- 15 + years. Location- Bangalore/PUNE/Noida/Chennai/Hyderabad Key Responsibilities
1. Solution Architecture & Design Lead SAP SD solution design across multiple large-scale transformation projects. Define end‑to‑end SD architecture covering OTC processes, pricing, taxation, deliveries, and billing. Create detailed solution blueprints, functional specs, and integration maps. Ensure alignment with S/4HANA best practices and industry standards.
2. SAP SD Functional Expertise Strong experience in core SD processes: Order Management & ATP Pricing, Discounts, Rebates, Surcharges Delivery Processing & Shipping Billing (Invoice, Credit/Debit Notes) Credit Management Contracts & Scheduling Agreements Intercompany Processing Third‑party & Consignment processes Hands-on knowledge of SD master data: Customer master, Partner functions, Material master, Condition records, Output types, etc.
3. Cross-functional Integration Architect seamless integration with MM, FI/CO, PP, EWM, TM, and GTS. Work closely with technical teams on RICEFW objects, interfaces, BTP extensions, and APIs. Collaborate with business stakeholders to map end-to-end OTC cycles.
4. Project Delivery Lead requirement workshops, Fit–Gap analysis, and solution validation. Prepare functional specifications and guide technical teams. Oversee SIT, UAT, cut-over, and go-live activities. Provide expertise during hypercare and stabilization phases.
5. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Mentor and guide SD consultants and cross-functional teams. Act as the primary SD point of contact for business and project leadership. Support presales activities, solution estimates, and proposal building. Required Skills & Experience 10–18+ years of SAP SD experience (customize based on level). Minimum 2–3 end-to-end S/4HANA implementations in a solution architect role. Deep understanding of Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes. Strong expertise in SD-FI, SD-MM, SD-EWM, SD-TM integrations. Hands-on experience with configuration, pricing procedures, and taxation (GST, VAT, etc.). Ability to design complex, scalable, and high-performance OTC solutions. Strong experience in writing functional specifications and leading technical builds. S/4HANA Sales certification (highly preferred). Experience with SAP Public Cloud / SAP GROW (optional). Exposure to SAP BTP, APIs, CPI integrations (added advantage). Experience in Agile/Activate methodology.

title: Engineer-Cybersecurity
requiredSkills: Continuously monitor SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and log sources for suspicious activity.
Perform initial triage and classification of alerts based on severity, scope, and impact.
Escalate validated incidents to L2 SOC analysts in line with SOC playbooks and escalation matrix.
Verify log ingestion and forwarding from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and other security platforms.
Identify tool or data gaps and escalate to L2 SOC or security engineering teams.
Maintain accurate and detailed incident records, triage notes, and escalation details.
Document recurring false positives and suggest playbook improvements.
Create and update tickets in the SOC case management system.
Serve as the first point of contact for customer-reported security incidents.
Perform preliminary analysis of suspicious emails, URLs, and attachments.
Follow MSSP and customer-specific SLA-driven escalation workflows.
Review vulnerability scan reports and escalate high-severity findings to L2/security engineers.
Experience in Vulnerability management
Assist in preparing daily/weekly SOC dashboards, reports, and metrics for management and customers.

jobDescription:
Area(s) of responsibility About Birlasoft: Birlasoft, a global leader at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and Digital technologies, seamlessly blends domain expertise with enterprise solutions. The company’s consultative and design-thinking approach empowers societies worldwide, enhancing the efficiency and productivity of businesses. As part of the multibillion-dollar diversified CKA Birla Group, Birlasoft with its 12,000+ professionals, is committed to continuing the Group’s 170-year heritage of building sustainable communities.
1. About the Job – Ability to relate the product functionality to business processes, and thus offer implementation advice to customers on how to meet their various business scenarios.
2. Job Title – Lead Apriso Consultant
3. Location: Bangalore/Pune/Mumbai/Noida/Hyderabad/Chennai
4. Key Responsibilities
5.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Technology or equivalent Experience: • Minimum 6 to 8 years in MES and Manufacturing domain • 3+ years of object-oriented programming experience • Should have working experience in any of the Apriso version starting 2016 till
2023. • Good knowledge and working experience in o Apriso Production o Apriso Quality o Apriso Warehouse o Apriso Maintenance o Apriso Time & Labor o Apriso Process Builder, Machine Integrator, Business Integrator • Good knowledge of Apriso dashboard and MPI is added advantage. • Must be proficient in Java Script/ C# Script and SQL Server/Oracle. • CSS/HTML, AJAX, j Query, JSON knowledge is a plus Experience in Apriso. • Must have been part of one or more end to end MES implementations using any of the Apriso version mentioned above. • Must have hands-on experience in creating as-is and to-be process documentation, user requirements, functional specifications, technical design documents, user manuals, and functional design specifications. • Well versed with deployment and release management processes through GPM. • Hands-on experience on Process Builder, Machine Integration and Business Integration. • Must have built mapping for ERP integration and OPC integration. • Familiar with source control/versioning concepts and creating scripts for database objects. • Well versed with SDLC methodologies.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Create appropriate technical designs based on functional specifications. • Author processes in Apriso using Process Builder. • Build interfaces and mapping using Apriso or third-party tools. • Configure and develop required extensions to the Apriso software suite. • Configure and develop required interfaces to disparate external system and hardware. • Create appropriate technical and functional test plans and ensure quality of developed software. • Execution of system and integration testing at customer site together with customer • Provide technical support for MES system until transition to support. • Ensure overall quality of final solution. • Manage small team of analysts, developers, testers or engineers and drive delivery of a small module within a project (Delivery/Maintenance/Testing).

title: Senior Network Tech Lead
jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility Position Title: Senior Network Tech Lead Experience Required: 10+ years Location: India (Preferred Bangalore, Pune or Noida, but flexible for, Hyderabad, Chennai) Department: Network Practice Delivery Job Summary We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Network Tech Lead for implementation, troubleshooting and operations of large-scale enterprise Campus, WAN, and Data Center networks for our customers. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in network implementation & support, SDN/SD-WAN platforms (including Velo-cloud SD-WAN, Palo Alto, firewalls, Aruba Clear Pass, Prima access), and cloud networking (Azure, AWS). The role requires proven project leadership, customer engagement, technical team management, and a strong track record in delivering successful network solutions. Key Responsibilities • Lead the implementation & support of robust LAN, WAN, Data Centre, and SDN/SD-WAN solutions. • Support Low-Level Designs (LLD), and technical solution proposals to customers. • Engage directly with customers to understand requirements and manage technical calls. • Support project delivery, ensuring successful implementation, issue resolution, and customer satisfaction. • Implement or migrate the defined design into the production and ensure the smooth cut over or installation of the network. • Guide and mentor a team of Junior network engineers, driving technical excellence and team development. • Serve as the technical escalation point (L2/L3) for complex network issues and critical incidents. • Define and enforce network documentation standards, maintaining a comprehensive engineering document library. • Collaborate with OEMs, vendors, and cross-functional teams for, implementation, integration & support. • Execute or Support network migration, integration, and transformation projects, including service recovery and improvement initiatives. • Document and hand over the implementation, support hyper care. Required Skills & Qualifications • 10+ years of hands-on experience in network implementation, support, and operations. • Proven experience leading projects and operations for customer environments. • Strong fundamentals in Routing & Switching (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, STP, RSTP, MSTP, VTP, Ether Channel, HSRP, VRRP, VSS, VPC, VDC, FEX, Fabric Path). • Hands-on experience architecting and delivering solutions on: o Primary Skills  Strong base of Routing & Switching  Velo-Cloud SDWAN  Aruba Clear Pass  Cisco ISE, DNAC o Secondary Skills  SDN/SD-WAN platforms (Cisco SD-WAN)  Solar Winds Orion • Experience with network security platforms (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA) and network access control. • Cloud networking expertise: Good to have worked on Azure networking (Vnet, Virtual Network Gateways, Site-to-Site IPsec connections, Network Security Group, Virtual network Gateway, Local Network Gateway, Route Tables & management, etc.). AWS Networking (VPC, Transit gateway, Direct-connect, Cloud Watch, IGW, NAT GW, Security Groups, ALB, NLB, GLB Certificate manager, R53, Multi-cloud Integrations. • Certification Requirements: o CCNA, CCNP or equivalent certification is mandatory. o Azure AZ-700, AWS ANS-C01 or equivalent certification is good to have. • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, mentor junior engineers, and manage project delivery. • Excellent communication, presentation, and customer engagement skills. • Strong documentation capabilities and process awareness. • Experience working with vendors and partners on solution implementation support & troubleshoot. Education • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

title: Technical Specialist-App Development
requiredSkills: Monitoring and Automation : Proactively monitor software systems to prevent incidents and automate routine tasks.
Effective Monitoring : Build monitoring systems that alert based on symptoms rather than outages.
Application Performance Monitoring (APM) : Implement and utilize APM tools such as New Relic or Dynatrace to monitor application performance, identify bottlenecks, and optimize resource usage.
Log Analysis with Splunk : Analyse logs using Splunk to troubleshoot issues, detect anomalies, and improve system reliability.
Dashboards Preparation : Create informative dashboards to visualize system health, performance, and key metrics.
Alerts Setup : Configure alerts based on thresholds and anomalies to promptly address issues.
Reports Scheduling : Set up regular reports to provide insights into system performance and reliability.
Reliability Metrics : Establish and track reliability metrics (e.g., SLOs, SLIs, error budgets) to measure system performance.
Observability Skills : Proficiency in observability practices, including distributed tracing, logging, and metrics collection.
Collaboration : Partner with development, support teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures.
Capacity Planning : Participate in system design consulting and capacity planning.
Debugging and Incident Response : Understand debugging information, handle incidents, and roll back faulty software pushes.
Automation : Handson experience in automation using Python, Bash
AIOps : Familiar with GenAI, Agentic AI frameworks. Understanding of leveraging agents in AIOps implementation across monitoring, observability, ITSM, Change/Incident Management, PagerDuty
Mentoring L1/L2 Support Teams : Provide guidance, mentorship to establish best practices on monitoring and observability.
Infrastructure Management : Run and manage infrastructure using tools like Chef, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, and Kubernetes.
Documentation : Document processes and procedures to avoid redundancy.
Enthusiastic Attitude : Approach challenges with enthusiasm and a proactive mindset.

jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility Role Summary The Global Service Desk (GSD) Russian Language Support Expert is responsible for providing L1/L1.5 IT support to global users, with a focus on Russian-speaking regions. The role ensures efficient incident resolution, service request fulfillment, and high customer satisfaction through strong troubleshooting capabilities and multilingual communication skills. Key Responsibilities • Provide IT support (L1/L1.5) in Russian and English across global users • Handle incidents and service requests via calls, emails, and chat • Troubleshoot issues related to applications, systems, and infrastructure • Ensure tickets are logged, categorized, and resolved within SLA • Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 teams with proper documentation • Maintain accurate updates and resolution notes in ticketing tools • Follow ITIL processes (Incident, Request, Knowledge Management) • Contribute to knowledge base articles and SOP documentation • Support 24x7 global operations (shift-based model) Language & Communication Requirements • Fluent in Russian (spoken and written) – mandatory • Good proficiency in English • Ability to communicate effectively with global users • Experience in voice support is an advantage Technical Skills • Experience with Service Now or similar ITSM tools • Knowledge of Windows OS, Office 365, Outlook, and collaboration tools • Understanding of VPN, networking basics, and remote access tools • Exposure to Active Directory (user and access management) • Familiarity with enterprise applications (SAP, JDE, etc. is a plus) Process & Compliance • Adhere to ITIL processes (Incident, Request, Knowledge) • Ensure audit-ready documentation for all tickets • Follow IT security and compliance guidelines • Adhere to escalation matrix and governance practices Skills & Competencies • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills • Excellent communication (verbal and written) • Customer-focused mindset • Ability to handle high ticket volumes efficiently • Flexibility to work in shifts across time zones Experience & Qualifications • 2–5 years of experience in IT Service Desk / Technical Support • Proven experience in Russian language support • ITIL Foundation certification preferred • Graduate in IT/Computer Science or related field Key Metrics (KPIs) • SLA compliance (response and resolution) • First Call Resolution (FCR) • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) • Ticket backlog and aging • Quality audit scores Tools & Platforms • Service Now (Incident, Request, Knowledge modules) • Remote support tools • MS Teams, Outlook, and collaboration tools Career Progression • Senior Service Desk Analyst • Language SME • Service Desk Lead roles

title: Assistant Manager-Pre Sales
requiredSkills: Leading the end-to-end bid process, including opportunity identification, qualification and proposal submission.
Developing and executing bid strategies that align with the company’s goals and client requirements.
Coordinating with various teams, including sales, technical, legal and finance to ensure all aspects of a bid are addressed.
Managing bidding budgets, resources and timelines to ensure on-time and high-quality proposal submissions.
Identifying new business opportunities by monitoring public and private sector tender portals.
Maintaining comprehensive and accurate bid documentation, including bid files, records of communication and pricing information.
Participating in negotiation sessions to secure favourable terms and conditions while focusing on profitability.
Ensuring compliance with client requirements, regulations and industry standards.
Monitoring and evaluating bid performance metrics to identify areas for improvement.
Identify and evaluate new business opportunities through market research, competitor analysis and client needs assessment.
Lead and coordinate the entire bid management process, including reviewing bid invitations, conducting bid/no-bid analysis and establishing timelines.
Develop compelling and persuasive bid content, including executive summaries, value propositions, pricing models and technical responses.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as sales, operations and subject matter experts, to gather information and develop bid strategies.
Coordinate and facilitate bid review meetings, ensuring key stakeholders provide input and address concerns or issues.
Work with pricing teams to develop competitive pricing strategies that align with bid requirements and profitability targets.
Coordinate with legal and compliance teams to ensure bid proposals meet all legal and regulatory requirements.
Monitor and track bid performance metrics, analysing win/loss data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
Conduct post-bid analysis and debrief sessions to identify areas of improvement and implement lessons learned for future bids.
Continuously refine and improve bid processes, templates and best practices to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
Stay updated on industry trends, market insights and emerging best practices in bid management.
Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a related field.
5+ years of experience as a bid manager, proposal manager or a similar role, preferably in India.
Experience in managing bids for complex projects or large-scale contracts.
Knowledge of Indian government procurement processes and regulations.
Demonstrated success in winning bids through effective proposal management.
Strong understanding of the bid lifecycle, proposal writing, development and contract negotiation.
Being well acquainted with the Indian market, contract laws and regulations.
Proficiency in using bid management software and MS Office.
Ability to implement budgetary and cost-control measures with solid negotiation and persuasive skills.
Attention to detail and high accuracy in bid preparation and review.
Familiarity with government procurement processes and industry-specific bid requirements (if applicable).
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders at various levels.

jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility Roles and Responsibilities An Overview of Key Functions and Duties Introduction Aisera is an AI-driven platform designed to automate workflows, enhance user experience, and improve productivity across various business operations. Understanding the roles and responsibilities within the Aisera tool is essential for maximizing its potential and ensuring effective implementation. Administrator The Administrator is responsible for configuring and managing the Aisera platform. Key duties include: User management: Adding, removing, and updating user permissions. System configuration: Setting up integrations, workflows, and automation rules. Monitoring platform health: Ensuring uptime, troubleshooting issues, and applying updates. Security oversight: Managing access controls and ensuring compliance with organizational policies. AI Developer / Engineer AI Developers or Engineers focus on customizing and optimizing the AI models within Aisera. Their responsibilities include: Training AI models: Using company data to improve response accuracy and relevance. Integrating APIs: Connecting Aisera to other enterprise tools and platforms. Testing and validation: Ensuring AI performance meets business requirements. Continuous improvement: Updating algorithms and features based on feedback and analytics. Service Desk Agent Service Desk Agents interact with Aisera to resolve user queries and incidents. Their roles involve: Monitoring AI-generated tickets and responses. Escalating complex issues to human agents when necessary. Providing feedback to improve AI effectiveness. Ensuring customer satisfaction by leveraging automation for faster resolution. End Users End Users are the primary beneficiaries of Aisera’s automation. Their responsibilities are minimal but include: Submitting requests or tickets through the platform. Interacting with AI chatbots or virtual agents. Providing feedback on service quality and accuracy. Business Owner / Stakeholder Business Owners or Stakeholders oversee the strategic implementation of Aisera. Their responsibilities include: Defining objectives and KPIs for Aisera deployment. Evaluating ROI and user adoption rates. Aligning Aisera’s capabilities with business goals. Driving change management and promoting platform utilization. Conclusion Aisera’s success depends on the collaboration of multiple roles, each with distinct responsibilities. Clear understanding and communication among Administrators, Developers, Service Desk Agents, End Users, and Business Stakeholders ensure the tool delivers maximum value and fosters innovation across the organization. Key Responsibilities • 8+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Success Factors, with strong expertise in Employee Central (EC) and Time Off modules. • Proven experience in end-to-end implementation, support, enhancements, and production issue resolution across SAP Success Factors modules. • Candidates must possess valid Success Factors certifications in both Employee Central (EC) and Time Off, demonstrating expertise in configuration, implementation, support, and maintenance of these modules. • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and design solutions within the Success Factors system. • Translate business requirements into comprehensive system design specifications. • Provide guidance and support to business stakeholders on system functionality and best practices. • • Understand the technology landscape, client business areas, functional trends, industry direction, and value propositions for adopting new solutions. • Identify and troubleshoot SAP Success Factors Integration Issues and develop effective solutions to address business and technical challenges. • Possess hands-on experience across multiple Success Factors modules, with the ability to understand cross-module dependencies and impacts. • Design, build, and maintain Canvas Reports and Story Reports, providing insightful analytics and reporting solutions to meet business requirements. • • Demonstrate strong understanding of Role-Based Permissions (RBP), including security design, access management, and troubleshooting permission-related issues. • Configure and enhance role-based permissions in alignment with business requirements while ensuring data security and compliance. • Provide ongoing support, issue resolution, and system optimization for Success Factors applications. requiredSkills: Experience with IBM Sterling B2B Integrator (B2Bi) development and support.
Sterling admin knowledge/upgrade/transformation must have skill
Knowledge of EDI standards such as X12, EDIFACT, XML, and Flat Files.
Good experience with XSLT transformation.
Must have good knowledge of mapping specifications
Development of Sterling Maps and Business Processes (BPML).
Trading Partner onboarding and configuration.
Experience with communication protocols:
AS2
SFTP/FTP
HTTP/HTTPS
MQ
Monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
Understanding of security concepts such as PGP, SSL certificates, and encryption.
Basic knowledge of IBM MQ c oncepts and messaging architecture.
Understanding of queue managers, queues, channels, and message flow.
Exposure to MQ-based integrations and asynchronous messaging patterns.
Ability to work with MQ connectivity in Sterling and ACE environments.
Understanding of IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) architecture.
Basic knowledge of message flows, message transformation, and routing.
Understanding of enterprise integration patterns.
Basic understanding of Azure services such as:
Azure Storage Accounts
Azure Service Bus
Azure Functions
Azure Monitor
Knowledge of deployment concepts and hybrid integration architecture.
Design, develop, and maintain B2B integrations using IBM Sterling B2Bi.
Develop and support EDI maps, business processes, and partner onboarding activities.
Integrate Sterling with ERP, API, and cloud-based systems.
Support REST/SOAP APIs and file-based integrations.
Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.
Collaborate with business stakeholders and external partners.
Participate in deployment, testing, and release activities.
Maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.
Good understanding of EDI/B2B integration concepts.
Knowledge of Database eg. SQL server etc.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, Git, and Agile methodologies.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

title: SAP BTP Senior Architect
jobDescription: About Birlasoft: Birlasoft, a global leader at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and Digital technologies, seamlessly blends domain expertise with enterprise solutions. The company’s consultative and design-thinking approach empowers societies worldwide, enhancing the efficiency and productivity of businesses. As part of the multibillion-dollar diversified CKA Birla Group, Birlasoft with its 12,000+ professionals, is committed to continuing the Group’s 170-year heritage of building sustainable communities. About the Job – We are looking for SAP BTP Senior Architect Educational Background – Any Graduate. Experience- 18 + years. Location- Bangalore/PUNE/Noida/Chennai/Hyderabad Responsibilites: SAP BTP Integration Suite with advanced capabilities in: Banking Integrations for payment processing, reconciliation, and secure data exchange. API Management for designing, publishing, and securing APIs across hybrid environments. SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) with proficiency in Groovy scripting for custom logic and transformations. End-to-End Integration Scenarios between: SAP S/4HANA (Public Cloud & RISE) and Success Factors, Concur, Ariba, SAP CX, and multiple third-party systems. Handling multi-hop integrations, asynchronous messaging, and event-driven architectures for real-time data flow. Complex Integration Patterns: Orchestrating multi-system workflows involving SAP and non-SAP applications. Implementing secure OAuth2-based connectivity, token management, and data encryption for compliance. Designing high-volume, fault-tolerant interfaces for mission-critical processes like payroll, procurement, and banking. Proven Experience in multiple SAP RISE & GROW implementation projects, delivering scalable and resilient integration frameworks. .

Experience with Agile / Scrum delivery models
Exposure to Guidewire Cloud (GWCP) implementations
Guidewire Analyst Suite Certification.
Automation experience using GW testing accelerators, UFT, Selenium, or custom frameworks
Understanding of actuarial pricing inputs and loss cost calculations
Experience supporting multi-state or multi-LOB rating programs
SQL (basic validation of rating data)
Test automation tools (optional)

title: Lead - Oracle PIM
jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility Empowered By Innovation Birlasoft, a global leader at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and Digital technologies, seamlessly blends domain expertise with enterprise solutions. The company’s consultative and design-thinking approach empowers societies worldwide, enhancing the efficiency and productivity of businesses. Job Title / Position: Oracle Product Information Management Lead Experience: 7-9 years Location: Pune, Mumbai, Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai, Bangalore Role Summary The Oracle PIM is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing Oracle Product Information Management (PIM) solutions to support product master data governance, item lifecycle management, product onboarding, classification, catalog management, and downstream syndication across enterprise applications. requiredSkills: Core Development: Build, maintain, and scale web applications, microsites, and portals using Xperience by Kentico .

Integration: Build secure API connections and integrations between Kentico and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, payment gateways) using REST, GraphQL, or built-in event handlers.

Quality & Performance: Ensure web platforms are optimized for security, SEO, and fast performance.

Front-End Technologies: Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks (e.g., React, Vue.js, or Angular) for headless implementations.
Kentico Skills: Hands-on experience with Xperience by Kentico (or Kentico Xperience 13) architecture, including content modeling and continuous integration (CI/CD) workflows.
Database Management: Strong knowledge of SQL Server and database design.
Certifications: Active Kentico Certified Developer credential.
Cloud & SaaS: Experience deploying enterprise CMS projects to the cloud (Azure, AWS, or Kentico SaaS).
Headless CMS: Experience building decoupled/headless architectures and consuming GraphQL/REST APIs

requiredSkills: 10-12 Years of experience in Hyperion, Essbase, HFM, EPBCS, FCCS, EPRCS & PCMCS.

Support for planning artifacts: forms, dashboards, task lists and metadata changes

Exposure to EDMCS, EDMCS integration with ERP Cloud and all other EPM modules and formal metadata governance processes.

jobDescription:
Area(s) of responsibility Role Summary We are seeking a seasoned Senior Azure Data Engineer / Sr. Technical Lead with extensive expertise in Azure Databricks, Py Spark, ADF, SQL, and modern data engineering practices. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands on engineering capabilities, and the ability to design, architect, and deliver enterprise-scale data solutions. The ideal candidate will lead complex data initiatives, mentor engineering teams, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to build a robust and scalable data ecosystem on Azure. Key Responsibilities
1. Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership Lead the design, development, and deployment of large-scale data engineering solutions using Azure Databricks, Py Spark, SQL, ADF, and Azure Data Lake. Architect end-to-end Modern Data Warehouse (MDW) and Lakehouse solutions, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and cost optimization. 2. Data Pipeline Engineering Build, optimize, and maintain scalable, high performance ELT/ETL pipelines to process large volumes of structured and unstructured data. Utilize Delta Lake capabilities—ACID transactions, schema evolution, versioning, time travel—to manage enterprise-grade datasets. Perform cluster-level tuning, optimization of shuffle operations, caching, partitioning, and job parallelization. Manage Databricks job pipelines, notebooks, clusters, job scheduling, and integration with CI/CD pipelines.

Enforce best practices for security, access control, encryption, data lineage, and auditability. Prepare and maintain detailed documentation: technical specification documents, interface designs, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.
5. Stakeholder Collaboration & Team Leadership Collaborate with BI, analytics, business teams, and architects to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions. title: Technical Lead-Cloud & Infra Engg
jobDescription:
Area(s) of responsibility AWS RDS Support Engineer Experience: 7 to 10 Years
- Experience with AWS Services, RDS, Aurora, VPC, IAM
- Experience with database Postgre SQL, My SQL and Oracle
- Experience in AWS SCT/DMS Services
- Experience in Maintaining documentation for operational processes, runbooks, and SOPs
- Experience in Modifying RDS parameters (e.g., parameter groups, instance classes), manage users and access controls (IAM, DB-level permissions), handle elevated access requests (e.g., temporary admin access)
- Troubleshooting
- RCA
- Experience in Infra Provisioning and configuring Security components, Key pair, security groups, ACL, IAM, Directory Service, Certificate manager
- Experience provisioning and managing resources on cloud platforms using Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) tools such as Terraform or Cloud Formation
- Experience in managing Terraform pipelines for resource modifications (instance types, storage scaling), cluster size adjustments (Aurora clusters, read replicas)
- Experience in Monitor Cloud Watch, Splunk and New Relic for centralized monitoring, set up and maintain alarms for key metrics (CPU, memory, storage, replica lag), monitor database activity, health, and performance trends
- Should have a deep understanding of Iaa S and Paa S services offered on cloud platforms and understand how to use them together to build complex solutions.

jobDescription:
Area(s) of responsibility Job Title: Apex Developer Location: Noida/Pune/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Navi Mumbai Experience:4-6 years Mode
- Hybrid Role
- Fulltime Notice
- Immediate Only Role Summary We are looking for an experienced Oracle APEX Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise applications using Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, and Oracle Database technologies. The role involves application development, system integration, performance optimization, and ongoing support of business-critical applications. Key Responsibilities • Develop and maintain applications using Oracle APEX. • Design and optimize SQL queries, PL/SQL packages, procedures, and functions. • Build dashboards, reports, forms, and workflows. • Integrate Oracle APEX applications with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs. • Troubleshoot and resolve application and database issues. • Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards. • Support application deployments, upgrades, and production support activities. Required Skills • Oracle APEX (20.x/21.x/22.x/23.x) • Oracle SQL & PL/SQL • Oracle Database (12c/19c/21c) • Java Script, HTML5, CSS • ORDS (Oracle REST Data Services) • REST/SOAP Web Services • Git, Azure Dev Ops, Jira Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field. • 5+ years of Oracle development experience. • Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle APEX, SQL, and PL/SQL. • Experience working in Agile development environments. Preferred Skills • Oracle Forms to APEX migration. • Oracle EBS/Fusion integrations. • Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). • Performance tuning and application modernization experience.

jobDescription: About Birlasoft: Birlasoft, a powerhouse where domain expertise, enterprise solutions, and digital technologies converge to redefine business processes. We take pride in our consultative and design thinking approach, driving societal progress by enabling our customers to run businesses with unmatched efficiency and innovation. As part of the CK Birla Group, a multibillion-dollar enterprise, we boast a 12,500+ professional team committed to upholding the Group's 162-year legacy. Our core values prioritize Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives, along with Corporate Sustainable Responsibility (CSR) activities, demonstrating our dedication to building inclusive and sustainable communities. Join us in shaping a future where technology seamlessly aligns with purpose. Job Description – Senior Engineer Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to design, develop, implement, and support high-quality technology solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, problem-solving capabilities, and experience working in agile environments. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, mentoring junior engineers, and contributing to the successful delivery of projects while ensuring adherence to quality, security, and performance standards. Key Responsibilities • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable and reliable software solutions. • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications. • Participate in architecture discussions and technology evaluations. • Develop and review code to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues. • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders. • Perform code reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. • Ensure application performance, security, scalability, and reliability. • Contribute to CI/CD implementation and Dev Ops practices. • Support production deployments and provide post-release support. • Prepare technical documentation, design documents, and knowledge-sharing materials. • Continuously improve engineering processes, tools, and methodologies. Required Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. • 5–8 years of relevant industry experience. • Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, .NET, Python, Java Script, or similar technologies. • Experience with database technologies (SQL/No SQL). • Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies. • Experience with source control tools such as Git. • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

title: Desktop Support - Sr Engineer-Cloud & Infra Engg
jobDescription: Area(s) of responsibility Job Title: Onsite Desktop Support Engineer (EUC / AV L1 / Logistics Coordination) Location: Onsite Experience: 2–4 years Shift: General / As per business requirement Job Summary The Onsite Desktop Support Engineer will be responsible for delivering reliable end user computing (EUC) support, providing Level 1 assistance for Audio Visual (AV) infrastructure, coordinating laptop shipment and receipt with external courier partners, and offering hand and feet support to infrastructure teams. The role requires strong coordination skills, hands on troubleshooting capabilities, and excellent user engagement. This position acts as the first physical touchpoint for IT support at the site and plays a critical role in asset lifecycle management and smooth IT operations. Key Responsibilities End User Computing (EUC) & Deskside Support Provide onsite L1/L2 support for desktops, laptops, peripherals, printers, and accessories. Perform OS installation, re imaging, software installation, patching, and basic troubleshooting. Resolve incidents and service requests as per defined SLA and ITSM processes (Service Now or equivalent). Support new joiner onboarding and employee exits (device handover, returns, data sanitization) Laptop Logistics & Courier Coordination Coordinate with external courier/logistics partners for: Shipment and receipt of laptops and accessories. Tracking consignments and ensuring timely delivery. Maintaining proof of delivery and escalation with vendors if required. Maintain accurate asset movement records (dispatch, receipt, inventory updates). Work closely with central IT/asset management teams for device lifecycle compliance. Infrastructure Coordination & Hand and Feet Support Provide hand and feet support for Network, Server, and Facilities/Infra teams during: Network troubleshooting Rack/patching activities Device replacements or site maintenance work Coordinate with L2/L3 infrastructure teams and vendors for issue resolution. Assist during audits, office moves, upgrades, or infrastructure refresh activities. Audio Visual (AV) Infrastructure – L1 Support Provide Level 1 support for Audio Visual infrastructure including: Meeting room AV systems VC devices (camera, mic, speaker, display panels) Projectors and digital signages Perform basic troubleshooting (connectivity, power, cabling, device checks). Coordinate with AV vendors or internal AV/L2 teams for complex issues. Support meetings and critical business events as required. Documentation & Compliance Ensure proper documentation of incidents, asset movement, and support activities. Adhere to IT security, compliance, and audit requirements. Maintain inventory accuracy and participate in periodic audits. Key Skills & Competencies Technical Skills Windows 10/11, basic mac OS troubleshooting Hardware diagnostics (laptops, desktops, peripherals) Basic networking knowledge (LAN/Wi Fi, cabling checks) Exposure to ITSM tools (Service Now preferred) Basic AV setup and troubleshooting Operational & Soft Skills Strong coordination and vendor management skills Excellent communication and customer handling abilities Ownership mindset and attention to detail Ability to work independently in an onsite role Educational Qualification Diploma / Graduate in IT, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Preferred Experience in onsite IT support / EUC roles Familiarity with AV meeting room setups

title: Salesforce Business Analyst with Data 360 and OneCRM
jobDescription:
Area(s) of responsibility Job Description — Salesforce Business Analyst with Data 360 and One CRM We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Business Analyst to support enterprise CRM transformation across two connected initiatives: Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) activating unified customer and commercial insights — and One CRM — consolidating people, processes and platforms onto a single, harmonized Salesforce instance across business units. Key Responsibilities Requirements & Discovery • Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process reviews with Veolia stakeholders across business units and regions. • Translate business needs into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications. • Map and harmonize "as-is" vs. "to-be" processes as part of the One CRM consolidation, identifying overlaps, gaps, and standardization opportunities. Data 360 / Data Cloud • Work with data and architecture teams to define data unification requirements — identity resolution, data model mapping, source onboarding, and harmonized customer/commercial profiles. • Define use cases that activate customer and commercial insights (segmentation, account 360 views, cross-sell/upsell, commercial reporting) and tie them to measurable business outcomes. • Support data quality, governance, and mapping rules across source systems feeding Data

description:
Area(s) of responsibility Job Description — Salesforce Business Analyst with Data 360 and One CRM We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Business Analyst to support enterprise CRM transformation across two connected initiatives: Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) activating unified customer and commercial insights — and One CRM — consolidating people, processes and platforms onto a single, harmonized Salesforce instance across business units. Key Responsibilities Requirements & Discovery • Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process reviews with Veolia stakeholders across business units and regions. • Translate business needs into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications. • Map and harmonize "as-is" vs. "to-be" processes as part of the One CRM consolidation, identifying overlaps, gaps, and standardization opportunities. Data 360 / Data Cloud • Work with data and architecture teams to define data unification requirements — identity resolution, data model mapping, source onboarding, and harmonized customer/commercial profiles. • Define use cases that activate customer and commercial insights (segmentation, account 360 views, cross-sell/upsell, commercial reporting) and tie them to measurable business outcomes. • Support data quality, governance, and mapping rules across source systems feeding Data
360. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, and supporting Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) solutions. The OTM Consultant will work closely with clients to understand their transportation and logistics needs and deliver effective OTM solutions to optimize their supply chain processes. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Gather and analyze client requirements related to transportation and logistics operations. Configure and customize Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) modules based on client needs. Provide technical documentation and user manuals. Stay updated with the latest features and best practices of Oracle OTM.

title: Databricks - Lead Architect
jobDescription:
Area(s) of responsibility Databricks Sr. Architect
- 7A Grade Experience: 15 to 18 Years • Responsible for designing and implementing secure, scalable, and highly available cloud-based solutions • Experience in enterprise adoption ensures the integration of modern, AI-driven capabilities and aligns architecture with key business outcomes. • Experience in Implementing Agent Bricks to enable high‑quality, domain‑specific AI agents that automatically refine the performance using enterprise data. • Cloud Architect with experience in Azure along with experience in RFP and proposal writing • Experience in creating Data warehouse, data lakes for Reporting, AI and Machine Learning • Integrate Genie and AI‑BI tools to enable natural‑language analytics within Databricks One and the broader AI/BI suites. • Experience in Azure Databricks and ADF, Azure Synapse and Py Spark • Integrate Azure Data Lake, Dev Ops pipelines, and Databricks workflows to achieve seamless end-to-end automation. • Participate in pre-sales activities, including RFP and proposal writing • Experience with integration of different data sources with Data Warehouse and Data Lake is required • Understanding of data modelling and data architecture concepts • To be able to clearly articulate pros and cons of various technologies and platforms • Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that leverage AWS and Azure cloud • Define and implement cloud governance and best practices. • Identify and implement automation opportunities to increase operational efficiency. • Conduct knowledge sharing and training sessions to educate clients and internal teams on cloud technologies. Mandatory Technologies: Databricks, Py SPark, Azure Dev OPS, Databricks Genie, Agent Bricks

title: Lead Business Consultant
jobDescription:
Area(s) of responsibility PMO Operations Experience Required
- 8–10 Years Location – Bangalore Role Overview We are seeking an experienced and highly organized PMO to drive project governance, portfolio management, delivery excellence, and strategic program execution across the organization. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in managing enterprise-scale programs, stakeholder communication, PMO processes, risk management, and reporting frameworks. The PMO will work closely with business leaders, project managers, technology teams, and executive stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with organizational objectives. Key Responsibilities PMO Governance & Strategy * Establish and manage PMO governance frameworks, methodologies, and best practices. * Drive standardization of project management processes across portfolios and programs. * Ensure adherence to organizational policies, quality standards, and compliance requirements. * Define and track PMO KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms. Program & Portfolio Management * Manage multiple programs simultaneously with end-to-end ownership. * Support portfolio prioritization and strategic planning initiatives. * Conduct project reviews, health checks, and governance meetings. Stakeholder Management * Collaborate with senior leadership, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. * Provide executive-level status reporting and actionable insights. * Facilitate steering committee meetings and decision-making forums. * Ensure alignment between business objectives and project execution. Resource & Financial Management * Support resource planning, utilization tracking, and capacity management. * Monitor project budgets, forecasts, and financial performance. * Drive optimization of delivery costs and operational efficiency. Continuous Improvement * Identify opportunities to improve PMO maturity and delivery effectiveness. * Mentor project managers and team members on PMO best practices. * Drive adoption of Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies as applicable.
